note: Declarations are from byte-verified pinned Kconfig files; parent if/menu dependencies also apply and are verified by olddefconfig

entries.declaration:
config POSIX_MQUEUE
	bool "POSIX Message Queues"
	depends on NET

config POSIX_MQUEUE_SYSCTL
	bool
	depends on POSIX_MQUEUE
	depends on SYSCTL
	default y

menuconfig CGROUPS
	bool "Control Group support"
	select KERNFS

config MEMCG
	bool "Memory controller"
	select PAGE_COUNTER
	select EVENTFD
	select SLAB_OBJ_EXT
	select VM_EVENT_COUNTERS

config BLK_CGROUP
	bool "IO controller"
	depends on BLOCK
	default n

menuconfig CGROUP_SCHED
	bool "CPU controller"
	default n

config GROUP_SCHED_BANDWIDTH
	def_bool n

config FAIR_GROUP_SCHED
	bool "Group scheduling for SCHED_OTHER"
	depends on CGROUP_SCHED
	select GROUP_SCHED_WEIGHT
	default CGROUP_SCHED

config CFS_BANDWIDTH
	bool "CPU bandwidth provisioning for FAIR_GROUP_SCHED"
	depends on FAIR_GROUP_SCHED
	select GROUP_SCHED_BANDWIDTH
	default n

config CGROUP_PIDS
	bool "PIDs controller"

config CGROUP_FREEZER
	bool "Freezer controller"

config CGROUP_HUGETLB
	bool "HugeTLB controller"
	depends on HUGETLB_PAGE
	select PAGE_COUNTER
	default n

config CPUSETS
	bool "Cpuset controller"
	depends on SMP
	select UNION_FIND
	select CPU_ISOLATION

config CGROUP_DEVICE
	bool "Device controller"

config CGROUP_CPUACCT
	bool "Simple CPU accounting controller"

config CGROUP_PERF
	bool "Perf controller"
	depends on PERF_EVENTS

config CGROUP_BPF
	bool "Support for eBPF programs attached to cgroups"
	depends on BPF_SYSCALL
	select SOCK_CGROUP_DATA

menuconfig NAMESPACES
	bool "Namespaces support" if EXPERT
	depends on MULTIUSER
	default !EXPERT

config UTS_NS
	bool "UTS namespace"
	default y

config IPC_NS
	bool "IPC namespace"
	depends on (SYSVIPC || POSIX_MQUEUE)
	default y

config USER_NS
	bool "User namespace"
	default n

config PID_NS
	bool "PID Namespaces"
	default y

config NET_NS
	bool "Network namespace"
	depends on NET
	default y

config CHECKPOINT_RESTORE
	bool "Checkpoint/restore support"
	depends on PROC_FS
	select PROC_CHILDREN
	select KCMP
	default n

config BLK_DEV_THROTTLING
	bool "Block layer bio throttling support"
	depends on BLK_CGROUP
	select BLK_CGROUP_RWSTAT

config INET
	bool "TCP/IP networking"

menuconfig NETFILTER
	bool "Network packet filtering framework (Netfilter)"

config NETFILTER_ADVANCED
	bool "Advanced netfilter configuration"
	depends on NETFILTER
	default y

config BRIDGE_NETFILTER
	tristate "Bridged IP/ARP packets filtering"
	depends on BRIDGE
	depends on NETFILTER && INET
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED
	select NETFILTER_FAMILY_BRIDGE
	select SKB_EXTENSIONS

config CGROUP_NET_PRIO
	bool "Network priority cgroup"
	depends on CGROUPS
	select SOCK_CGROUP_DATA

config CGROUP_NET_CLASSID
	bool "Network classid cgroup"
	depends on CGROUPS
	select SOCK_CGROUP_DATA

config NET_CLS_CGROUP
	tristate "Control Group Classifier"
	select NET_CLS
	select CGROUP_NET_CLASSID
	depends on CGROUPS

config MACVLAN
	tristate "MAC-VLAN support"

config MACVTAP
	tristate "MAC-VLAN based tap driver"
	depends on MACVLAN
	depends on INET
	select TAP

config IPVLAN_L3S
	depends on NETFILTER
	depends on IPVLAN
	def_bool y
	select NET_L3_MASTER_DEV

config IPVLAN
	tristate "IP-VLAN support"
	depends on INET

config IPVTAP
	tristate "IP-VLAN based tap driver"
	depends on IPVLAN
	depends on INET
	select TAP

config VXLAN
	tristate "Virtual eXtensible Local Area Network (VXLAN)"
	depends on INET
	select NET_UDP_TUNNEL
	select GRO_CELLS

config VETH
	tristate "Virtual ethernet pair device"
	select PAGE_POOL

config NET_VRF
	tristate "Virtual Routing and Forwarding (Lite)"
	depends on IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES
	depends on NET_L3_MASTER_DEV
	depends on IPV6_MULTIPLE_TABLES || IPV6=n

config BRIDGE
	tristate "802.1d Ethernet Bridging"
	select LLC
	select STP

config BRIDGE_VLAN_FILTERING
	bool "VLAN filtering"
	depends on BRIDGE
	depends on VLAN_8021Q
	default n

config NF_CONNTRACK
	tristate "Netfilter connection tracking support"
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n
	select NF_DEFRAG_IPV4
	select NF_DEFRAG_IPV6 if IPV6 != n

config NF_NAT
	tristate "Network Address Translation support"
	depends on NF_CONNTRACK
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n

config NF_NAT_MASQUERADE
	bool

config NF_TABLES
	select NETFILTER_NETLINK
	select NET_CRC32C
	tristate "Netfilter nf_tables support"

config NF_TABLES_INET
	depends on IPV6
	select NF_TABLES_IPV4
	select NF_TABLES_IPV6
	bool "Netfilter nf_tables mixed IPv4/IPv6 tables support"

config NFT_CT
	depends on NF_CONNTRACK
	tristate "Netfilter nf_tables conntrack module"

config NFT_MASQ
	depends on NF_CONNTRACK
	depends on NF_NAT
	select NF_NAT_MASQUERADE
	tristate "Netfilter nf_tables masquerade support"

config NFT_REDIR
	depends on NF_CONNTRACK
	depends on NF_NAT
	tristate "Netfilter nf_tables redirect support"
	select NF_NAT_REDIRECT

config NFT_NAT
	depends on NF_CONNTRACK
	select NF_NAT
	depends on NF_TABLES_IPV4 || NF_TABLES_IPV6
	tristate "Netfilter nf_tables nat module"

config NFT_COMPAT
	depends on NETFILTER_XTABLES
	tristate "Netfilter x_tables over nf_tables module"

config NFT_FIB
	tristate

config NFT_FIB_INET
	depends on NF_TABLES_INET
	depends on NFT_FIB_IPV4
	depends on NFT_FIB_IPV6
	tristate "Netfilter nf_tables fib inet support"

config NETFILTER_XTABLES
	tristate "Netfilter Xtables support (required for ip_tables)"
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n

config NETFILTER_XTABLES_LEGACY
	bool "Netfilter legacy tables support"
	depends on !PREEMPT_RT

config NETFILTER_XT_MARK
	tristate 'nfmark target and match support'
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n

config NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_CHECKSUM
	tristate "CHECKSUM target support"
	depends on IP_NF_MANGLE || IP6_NF_MANGLE || NFT_COMPAT
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED

config NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_CT
	tristate '"CT" target support'
	depends on NF_CONNTRACK
	depends on IP_NF_RAW || IP6_NF_RAW || NFT_COMPAT
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED

config NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_DSCP
	tristate '"DSCP" and "TOS" target support'
	depends on IP_NF_MANGLE || IP6_NF_MANGLE || NFT_COMPAT
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED

config NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_HL
	tristate '"HL" hoplimit target support'
	depends on IP_NF_MANGLE || IP6_NF_MANGLE || NFT_COMPAT
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED

config NETFILTER_XT_NAT
	tristate '"SNAT and DNAT" targets support'
	depends on NF_NAT

config NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_NOTRACK
	tristate  '"NOTRACK" target support (DEPRECATED)'
	depends on NF_CONNTRACK
	depends on IP_NF_RAW || IP6_NF_RAW
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED
	select NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_CT

config NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_MASQUERADE
	tristate "MASQUERADE target support"
	depends on NF_NAT
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n
	select NF_NAT_MASQUERADE

config NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_TPROXY
	tristate '"TPROXY" target transparent proxying support'
	depends on NETFILTER_XTABLES
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED
	depends on IP6_NF_IPTABLES || IP6_NF_IPTABLES=n
	depends on IP_NF_MANGLE || NFT_COMPAT
	select NF_DEFRAG_IPV4
	select NF_DEFRAG_IPV6 if IP6_NF_IPTABLES != n
	select NF_TPROXY_IPV4
	select NF_TPROXY_IPV6 if IP6_NF_IPTABLES

config NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_TRACE
	tristate  '"TRACE" target support'
	depends on IP_NF_RAW || IP6_NF_RAW
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED

config NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_TCPOPTSTRIP
	tristate '"TCPOPTSTRIP" target support'
	depends on IP_NF_MANGLE || IP6_NF_MANGLE || NFT_COMPAT
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED

config NETFILTER_XT_MATCH_ADDRTYPE
	tristate '"addrtype" address type match support'
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n

config NETFILTER_XT_MATCH_CONNTRACK
	tristate '"conntrack" connection tracking match support'
	depends on NF_CONNTRACK
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n

config NETFILTER_XT_MATCH_IPVS
	tristate '"ipvs" match support'
	depends on IP_VS
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED
	depends on NF_CONNTRACK

menuconfig IP_VS
	tristate "IP virtual server support"
	depends on INET && NETFILTER
	depends on (NF_CONNTRACK || NF_CONNTRACK=n)

config	IP_VS_IPV6
	bool "IPv6 support for IPVS"
	depends on IPV6 = y || IP_VS = IPV6
	select NF_DEFRAG_IPV6

config	IP_VS_DEBUG
	bool "IP virtual server debugging"

config	IP_VS_TAB_BITS
	int "IPVS connection table size (the Nth power of 2)"
	range 8 20 if !64BIT
	range 8 27 if 64BIT
	default 12

config	IP_VS_PROTO_TCP
	bool "TCP load balancing support"

config	IP_VS_PROTO_UDP
	bool "UDP load balancing support"

config	IP_VS_PROTO_ESP
	bool "ESP load balancing support"

config	IP_VS_PROTO_AH
	bool "AH load balancing support"

config  IP_VS_PROTO_SCTP
	bool "SCTP load balancing support"
	select NET_CRC32C

config	IP_VS_RR
	tristate "round-robin scheduling"

config	IP_VS_WRR
	tristate "weighted round-robin scheduling"

config	IP_VS_LC
	tristate "least-connection scheduling"

config	IP_VS_WLC
	tristate "weighted least-connection scheduling"

config  IP_VS_FO
		tristate "weighted failover scheduling"

config  IP_VS_OVF
	tristate "weighted overflow scheduling"

config	IP_VS_LBLC
	tristate "locality-based least-connection scheduling"

config  IP_VS_LBLCR
	tristate "locality-based least-connection with replication scheduling"

config	IP_VS_DH
	tristate "destination hashing scheduling"

config	IP_VS_SH
	tristate "source hashing scheduling"

config	IP_VS_MH
	tristate "maglev hashing scheduling"

config	IP_VS_SED
	tristate "shortest expected delay scheduling"

config	IP_VS_NQ
	tristate "never queue scheduling"

config	IP_VS_TWOS
	tristate "weighted random twos choice least-connection scheduling"

config IP_VS_SH_TAB_BITS
	int "IPVS source hashing table size (the Nth power of 2)"
	range 4 20
	default 8

config IP_VS_MH_TAB_INDEX
	int "IPVS maglev hashing table index of size (the prime numbers)"
	range 8 17
	default 12

config	IP_VS_FTP
	tristate "FTP protocol helper"
	depends on IP_VS_PROTO_TCP && NF_CONNTRACK && NF_NAT && \
		NF_CONNTRACK_FTP
	select IP_VS_NFCT

config	IP_VS_NFCT
	bool "Netfilter connection tracking"
	depends on NF_CONNTRACK

config IP_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY
	tristate "Legacy IP tables support"
	depends on NETFILTER_XTABLES_LEGACY
	depends on NETFILTER_XTABLES
	default	m if NETFILTER_XTABLES_LEGACY

config NF_TABLES_IPV4
	bool "IPv4 nf_tables support"

config NFT_DUP_IPV4
	tristate "IPv4 nf_tables packet duplication support"
	depends on !NF_CONNTRACK || NF_CONNTRACK
	select NF_DUP_IPV4

config NFT_FIB_IPV4
	select NFT_FIB
	tristate "nf_tables fib / ip route lookup support"

config IP_NF_IPTABLES
	tristate "IP tables support (required for filtering/masq/NAT)"
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n
	select NETFILTER_XTABLES

config IP_NF_MATCH_RPFILTER
	tristate '"rpfilter" reverse path filter match support'
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED
	depends on IP_NF_MANGLE || IP_NF_RAW || NFT_COMPAT

config IP_NF_FILTER
	tristate "Packet filtering"
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n || IP_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY
	depends on IP_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY

config IP_NF_TARGET_REJECT
	tristate "REJECT target support"
	depends on IP_NF_FILTER || NFT_COMPAT
	select NF_REJECT_IPV4
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n

config IP_NF_NAT
	tristate "iptables NAT support"
	depends on NF_CONNTRACK
	depends on IP_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n
	select NF_NAT
	select NETFILTER_XT_NAT

config IP_NF_TARGET_MASQUERADE
	tristate "MASQUERADE target support"
	select NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_MASQUERADE

config IP_NF_TARGET_NETMAP
	tristate "NETMAP target support"
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED
	select NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_NETMAP

config IP_NF_TARGET_REDIRECT
	tristate "REDIRECT target support"
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED
	select NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_REDIRECT

config IP_NF_MANGLE
	tristate "Packet mangling"
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n || IP_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY
	depends on IP_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY

config IP_NF_TARGET_ECN
	tristate "ECN target support"
	depends on IP_NF_MANGLE || NFT_COMPAT
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED

config IP_NF_TARGET_TTL
	tristate '"TTL" target support'
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED && IP_NF_MANGLE
	select NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_HL

config IP_NF_RAW
	tristate  'raw table support (required for NOTRACK/TRACE)'
	depends on IP_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY

config IP_NF_SECURITY
	tristate "Security table"
	depends on SECURITY
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED
	depends on IP_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY

config IP_NF_ARPTABLES
	tristate "Legacy ARPTABLES support"
	depends on NETFILTER_XTABLES_LEGACY
	depends on NETFILTER_XTABLES
	default	n

config IP_NF_ARPFILTER
	tristate "arptables-legacy packet filtering support"
	select IP_NF_ARPTABLES
	select NETFILTER_FAMILY_ARP
	depends on NETFILTER_XTABLES_LEGACY
	depends on NETFILTER_XTABLES

config IP6_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY
	tristate "Legacy IP6 tables support"
	depends on INET && IPV6 && NETFILTER_XTABLES_LEGACY
	depends on NETFILTER_XTABLES
	default	m if NETFILTER_XTABLES_LEGACY

config NF_TABLES_IPV6
	bool "IPv6 nf_tables support"

config NFT_DUP_IPV6
	tristate "IPv6 nf_tables packet duplication support"
	depends on !NF_CONNTRACK || NF_CONNTRACK
	select NF_DUP_IPV6

config NFT_FIB_IPV6
	tristate "nf_tables fib / ipv6 route lookup support"
	select NFT_FIB

config IP6_NF_IPTABLES
	tristate "IP6 tables support (required for filtering)"
	depends on INET && IPV6
	select NETFILTER_XTABLES
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n

config IP6_NF_MATCH_RPFILTER
	tristate '"rpfilter" reverse path filter match support'
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED
	depends on IP6_NF_MANGLE || IP6_NF_RAW || NFT_COMPAT

config IP6_NF_TARGET_HL
	tristate '"HL" hoplimit target support'
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED && IP6_NF_MANGLE
	select NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_HL

config IP6_NF_FILTER
	tristate "Packet filtering"
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n || IP6_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY
	depends on IP6_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY
	tristate

config IP6_NF_TARGET_REJECT
	tristate "REJECT target support"
	depends on IP6_NF_FILTER || NFT_COMPAT
	select NF_REJECT_IPV6
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n

config IP6_NF_MANGLE
	tristate "Packet mangling"
	default m if NETFILTER_ADVANCED=n || IP6_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY
	depends on IP6_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY

config IP6_NF_RAW
	tristate  'raw table support (required for TRACE)'
	depends on IP6_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY

config IP6_NF_SECURITY
	tristate "Security table"
	depends on SECURITY
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED
	depends on IP6_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY

config IP6_NF_NAT
	tristate "ip6tables NAT support"
	depends on NF_CONNTRACK
	depends on NETFILTER_ADVANCED
	depends on IP6_NF_IPTABLES_LEGACY
	select NF_NAT
	select NETFILTER_XT_NAT

config IP6_NF_TARGET_MASQUERADE
	tristate "MASQUERADE target support"
	select NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_MASQUERADE
	depends on IP6_NF_NAT

config IP6_NF_TARGET_NPT
	tristate "NPT (Network Prefix translation) target support"
	depends on IP6_NF_NAT || NFT_COMPAT
